name: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Ltd
title: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Ltd - 532782 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 5.3% (up from 0.8% in Q1) on 3% lower FY revenue, but yarn price pass-through only protects margins and no capacity discipline is quantified; FY27 guidance is directional only.

utilisation.quote: our yarn division is operating at over 93%

capex.quote: This year, our budgets are obviously higher. It's very milestone-based.

triggers.label: Yarn prices passed through, margins protected
triggers.quote: the increase in yarn prices is a direct result of the raw material price increase, which is currently getting passed on to the market

triggers.label: Yarn utilisation 93%
triggers.quote: our yarn division is operating at over 93%

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA expansion directional, no numbers
triggers.quote: We expect EBITDA to expand meaningfully on the FY26 base, profitability to return after almost 2 years of losses

triggers.label: US subsidiary inventory losses, subsidiary closing
triggers.quote: That operation, we have kind of decided to close down or mute it down.

guidance.value: expand meaningfully on FY26 base; profitability return
guidance.quote: We expect EBITDA to expand meaningfully on the FY26 base, profitability to return after almost 2 years of losses

guidance.value: at least double in coming year
guidance.quote: we are very confident that we'll be able to at least double it or more in the coming year

guidance.value: one-third of yarn portfolio over 12 months
guidance.quote: The objective stands roughly converting one-third of our yarn portfolio into value-added segments over the next 12 months

red_flags.label: US subsidiary inventory losses; closing American Silk Mills
red_flags.quote: That operation, we have kind of decided to close down or mute it down.

red_flags.label: Nesterra top line stagnant for 4-6 quarters
red_flags.quote: in the last 4 or 6 quarters, our top line has been stagnated a bit

red_flags.label: Vague capex plan, milestone-based, numbers deferred
red_flags.quote: maybe a quarter or 2 quarters later, we'll be coming out with more definite numbers

evasions.topic: Yarn margin contribution from price rise
evasions.quote: there's no incremental contribution, which is coming to the spindles, but their margins are being protected at this point of time

evasions.topic: Double-digit margin timing and home textile EBITDA target
evasions.quote: I don't want to put a number.
maybe a quarter or 2 quarters later, we'll be coming out with more definite numbers
